profile.name: Mecademic工业机械臂
profile.description: 这是一类紧凑型工业机械臂，可配电动夹爪、真空夹具和I/O扩展模块，用于实验室和自动化工位中的精密抓取、搬运、装配、轨迹执行、工件定位与过程自动化。
profile.description_en: This is a compact industrial robot arm that can be equipped with an electric gripper, vacuum tool, and I/O expansion modules for precision pick-and-place, handling, assembly, trajectory execution, part positioning, and laboratory automation.
